newsitem.title: USA: U.S to sell $15 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills May 12.
newsitem.headline: U.S to sell $15 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills May 12.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $15 billion of three- and six-month bills on May 12 to pay down $5.075 billion as a total of $20.065 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued on May 15. The three-month bills mature on August 14 and the six-month bills mature on November 13.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127945J9 and for the six-month bills is 9127942W3.
